limitations: All six cached recordings are previously exposed development material, not fresh holdout; tracker parameters were not retuned here.
Guided extraction receives filename tempo and a declared +/-15 percent tempo range; beat timestamps and positions are withheld. This is not uninformed beat recognition.
Window error pools overlapping half-, one- and two-bar intervals inside observed pulse coverage; unsupported windows are reported separately. The 312 windows are not 312 independent recordings.
Near-correct duration counts do not imply correct pulse phase or bar starts. Downbeats/bar phase, chord boundaries, recorded strumming and whole arrangements are not evaluated.
Any-metrical-level continuity can reward half/double/offbeat pulses; it must not be read as quarter-note/downbeat accuracy.
No exact first-ten full-mix reference score is available; the five independent source candidates still need canonical-master/time-origin matching.
